summary: Iteration_9 validation for new 'origin' field (ads/analytics) + AdMob placeholder banner + no regression on solo game flow & home focus/blur. FRONTEND (Expo web 390x800 as tester1@belote.tn): ad-banner-placeholder present + visible on ALL 4 tabs (Accueil, Classement, Amis, Profil) sitting above the tab bar; no crash / no blank / no red-screen navigating between tabs. Solo game flow: play-solo-card → match-type-short → navigates to /game/g_2f33c786e60e (game table loaded, quit-game-button present); quit → quit-confirm-button → returns cleanly to /home. Home focus/blur regression: play-solo-card visible (y=262) by default, HIDES on join-code-input focus, RESTORES after blur/tab-renav — matches iteration_8 behaviour. AD banner still visible post-navigation. No new console errors beyond pre-existing RN Web shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings (unchanged since iteration_7). Interstitial (native-only) intentionally not visually tested per instructions. Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView / expo-av: none newly introduced by this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: game_manager.py:69 — origin defaults to 'online', explicitly set to 'solo' in server.py:426 and 'private' in game_manager.py:627 (start_room). Clean 3-value enum with no leakage.
game_logic.py:556-557 — origin + host_user_id both included in state_for() snapshot, so every WS 'update' carries them (verified in tests). No PII, safe for broadcast.

AdBanner.tsx — pure View placeholder with testID='ad-banner-placeholder', 46px height, correctly above tab bar via tabs/_layout.tsx wrapping <BottomTabBar /> in a parent <View>. adsNativeSupported gate ensures placeholder on web/Expo Go — real BannerAd only in native builds as intended.
AdBanner.tsx uses AD_UNITS.banner from config; no test IDs from Google leaked into web bundle. AdsProvider mounted only inside tabs/_layout so guest/auth screens don't include ads runtime.

game/[id].tsx:197 — quitAfterMatch calls maybeShowInterstitialAfterMatch(state.origin ?? 'online') then quit(); .finally() ensures navigation happens even if the interstitial promise rejects. Good defensive pattern for web (no-op) & native alike.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend contract: WS 'update' state carries origin ∈ {online,solo,private} and host_user_id (nullable for online games). test_origin_field.py is stable and cheap — reuse for regression. AdBanner is placeholder-only on web (testID 'ad-banner-placeholder', 46px above tab bar); native builds render <BannerAd/> with testID 'ad-banner-native' (untested here — needs a native build). Interstitial (interstitial.ts) is a no-op on web, AsyncStorage-backed frequency caps (1/2 for online+solo, 1/6 for private) — behavioural test would require native runtime. Pre-existing failing tests in test_rooms_matchmaking.py (obsolete players[] key vs seats[4]) and test_leave_then_rejoin_via_ws (flaky) remain — do not re-fix, they're already flagged as known-failing before this iteration.
